insert into stock_lockup_schedule ( stock_code, stock_name, free_date, free_shares, lift_market_cap, free_ratio, total_ratio, shares_type, holder_num, source, create_time, update_time ) values
(#{item.stockCode}, #{item.stockName}, #{item.freeDate}, #{item.freeShares}, #{item.liftMarketCap}, #{item.freeRatio}, #{item.totalRatio}, #{item.sharesType}, #{item.holderNum}, #{item.source}, sysdate(), sysdate())
on duplicate key update stock_name = values(stock_name), free_shares = values(free_shares), lift_market_cap = values(lift_market_cap), free_ratio = values(free_ratio), total_ratio = values(total_ratio), holder_num = values(holder_num), source = values(source), update_time = sysdate()
